sets.ref: published: 20 ppm is 'approximately 1 minute per month' (Analog Devices, former AN58); exact: 20e-6 x 86400 s = 1.728 s/day, x 2592000 s = 51.84 s per 30 d (0.864 min), x 31536000 s = 630.72 s per 365 d; df = 20e-6 x 32768 Hz = 0.65536 Hz

published: 5.0e-6 is '13 seconds of month deviation' (Seiko Epson RX8900 application manual); exact: 5e-6 x 86400 = 0.432 s/day, x 2592000 = 12.96 s, x 31536000 = 157.68 s; df = 5e-6 x 32768 = 0.16384 Hz (TI SLAA322D: 'within +-0.16 Hz')

published: 3.4e-6 is '9 seconds' per month (Seiko Epson RX8900 application manual); exact: 3.4e-6 x 86400 = 0.29376 s/day, x 2592000 = 8.8128 s, x 31536000 = 107.2224 s; df = 3.4e-6 x 32768 = 0.1114112 Hz
hand: 20e-6 x 16e6 Hz = 320 Hz; times 86400 = 1.728 s/day, 51.84 s per 30 d, 630.72 s per 365 d
hand: 10e-6 x 10e6 Hz = 100 Hz (a 10 MHz crystal 10 ppm off is 100 Hz off); 0.864 s/day, 25.92 s per 30 d, 315.36 s per 365 d

solve.ref: hand: the calculator gives the magnitude of the error (time and frequency are positive quantities): -20 ppm gives the same 1.728 s/day as +20 ppm
hand: 20000 ppm (2 %) x 86400 = 1728 s/day, x 32768 = 655.36 Hz; more than 10000 ppm is no crystal tolerance, the check fires
hand: exactly 10000 ppm (1 %) x 86400 = 864 s/day; the check needs more than 10000 ppm
hand: without the nominal frequency the time errors follow from ppm alone but the frequency error cannot be computed
